metadata.datasource: AF3-0221E2, March 2007 p.8; daylight, E-6/CR-56, Status A
metadata.license: CC0-1.0 (new numerical chart readings; source documents retain their copyright)
limitations: RVP50 E-6/CR-56 chart readings, independent of Velvia 100. Status-A to dye demixing is narrow-band approximate; neutral base, unmeasured spectral tails and grain remain assumptions.
RVP50 E-6／CR-56 独立图表读数，非 Velvia100 改名；Status A 到染料解混为窄带近似，中性片基、光谱尾部及颗粒仍是假设。
metadata.reading_precision: approx. 0.05 density, 5-10 nm and 0.1 log sensitivity; not instrument measurements
metadata.tails: constant endpoints outside chart range; not measured latitude
metadata.grain: equal thirds sublayer decomposition is assumed; no stock-specific spatial grain calibration
metadata.density_demixing: ASSUMED narrow-band 640/550/440 nm transmission densitometer inversion of Status-A chart readings; not fitted Status-A band integrals. Flat Dmin .06 base and out-of-chart spectral tails are assumptions.
metadata.density_domain: Transmission density of processed RVP50 reversal film, NOT an integral-reflection receiving layer.
